scope: Bounded blocked sampler plus amplitude/full-field rescaling; separate primary campaign

gates.coordinates: All five scalars and six fixed field projections

replay: Chain 0: copy checkpoint at trajectory 384; independently resume 64 trajectories and compare all committed draw bytes and summary against the primary run. Do not pool replay draws.
stopping: Stop at fixed budget, even on failed gates. No data-dependent extension, retuning, chain dropping or gate changes.
method: Unchanged blocked field/scalar sweep, then four full-field amplitude-rescaling MH attempts

field.metric: Frozen at chain initial scalar snapshot

scalars.method: Existing physical-coordinate joint amplitude/bias MH plus convex conditional bias slices; actual priors in target

component_seed: 53000 + chain*100000 + 2*outer_iteration for field; +1 for scalar block
comparison: Same target, initial states, gates, field/scalar settings and component seeds as blocked; only add rescaling block. Same retained count, greater compute cost; report cost and no pooling.
validation: Independent Gaussian-marginal quadrature with Gaussian/uniform amplitude priors and unused coordinates; reciprocal/Jacobian checks; shared/compact 1LPT/2LPT prediction/target checks; exact fresh-process replay, corruption and identity rejection

interweaving.coordinates: All stored real white coordinates including prior-only directions
interweaving.proposal: alpha_new reflected normal walk; white_new=(alpha/alpha_new)*white; biases fixed
